## Description {#details}

Struct template specialisation for extracting function traits from plain function types.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="R">The return type of the function.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="...Args&#95;T">The argument types of the function.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
This specialisation of the <code>function&#95;traits</code> struct template provides compile-time introspection for plain function types (i.e., non-pointer, non-member functions). It exposes the return type and argument types of a function, enabling advanced template metaprogramming and type deduction within the µTest++ framework.

The <code><Link to="#ae2c0f559e149f7cb6d9cfa59e4d02913">result&#95;type</Link></code> member defines the return type of the function, while the <code>args</code> member is a type list containing all argument types.
